svg.text: Carrier board for the Seeed XIAO ESP32-C6 · 100 × 75 mm, 2 layers · pins as in firmware/repeater_node (v3.3) + mains-present on D7
Power: mine supply or battery → 5 V (2 A)
Schottky OR: whichever input is higher feeds the board;
mine power cut → battery takes over with no reset
D3 P6KE36A TVS + C1 470 µF 50 V
on VPROT → GND: clamp surges and spikes
XIAO, 3 MQ heaters, matrix, buzzer, U3
LED1 power: +5V → R1 1 k → LED → GND
Mains-present (Q2 S8050): VIN_MAIN → R2 22 k → base,
R3 10 k base→GND, collector → MAINS_N, R4 10 k to +3V3.
Controller: Seeed XIAO ESP32-C6 (on sockets U2A / U2B)
u.FL → pigtail → SMA bulkhead antenna on the case
ADC only on GPIO0–6 → the three gas inputs use D0, D1, D2
Matrix interface: 3.3 V → 5 V (74HCT125, U3) + J7
MAX7219 needs ≥ 3.5 V logic-high at 5 V — the HCT buffer gives clean 5 V edges.
J7 MATRIX (XH-5): 1 +5V · 2 GND · 3 DIN5 · 4 CS5 · 5 CLK5 · C4 100 nF at U3
Gas inputs ×3: MQ sensor AO (0–5 V) → divider → ADC (0–3.3 V)
Firmware multiplies by 1.5 to recover the sensor voltage. MQ heaters ≈ 150 mA each from +5V.
Outputs and sensors on the right edge
Q1 S8050: base ← R5 1 k ← BUZ (D10), collector BUZ_N, emitter GND; D4 1N4148 across the buzzer
SOS J9 (XH-2): 1 SOS (D6, internal pull-up) · 2 GND · C5 100 nF debounce
AHT20 J6 (XH-4): 1 +3V3 · 2 GND · 3 SDA · 4 SCL · R6 / R7 4.7 k pull-ups to +3V3
flying lead so the sensor sits in the cool, vented chamber away from the MQ heaters
Mounting: 4 × M3 at the corners (3.5 mm in), board 100 × 75 mm
Nets: VIN_MAIN VIN_BAT VRAIL VPROT +5V +3V3 GND (0.8 mm tracks for power,
0.3 mm signals, 0.25 mm clearance), GND pour on both layers
